full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff filed a suit for declaration of title of the suit land and also further declaration that sole decree dated 18-7-1934 passed in Title Suit No. 441 of 1934 and sole decree passed in Partition Suit No. 4f of 1939 and Execution Case No. 29 of 1943 are collusive, fraudulent and forged. His further case is that he was minor at the time of filing of those suits and proceedings and though his mother knew to sign her name the Solenama was executed by thumb impression purported to have been put by her. Defendants contested the suit by filing joint written statement denying the material allegations and stating that they filed those two suits which ended in compromise. In the execution proceedings they got possession in the respective saham. On the basis of such possession MRR Khatian was prepared in their names. Plaintiff was not minor at that time and he and his mother put their signature arid thumb impression in the solenama. The suit was dismissed by the trial Court. On appeal by the plaintiff court of appeal below dismissed the appeal. Being aggrieved by the same plaintiff moved the High Court Division which summarily rejected the Revisional application.
